Sales Invoice Totals by Custom Field

The Sales Invoice Totals by Custom Field form configures custom field analysis.

Set parameters to analyze sales by custom field values.

Name

Enter a custom name for this report, or leave blank to use the default title.

This report analyzes sales by grouping invoices according to custom field values.

Custom Field

Select the custom field to group sales invoices by. The report will show totals for each unique value in this field.

For example, group by 'Product Category' to see sales per category, or by 'Sales Region' to compare regional performance.

Only custom fields assigned to sales invoices, invoice lines, customers, or inventory items are available.

Periods

Add one or more periods to compare sales totals across different time frames.

Each period creates a column showing totals for that date range, enabling trend analysis.

Common setups: monthly comparisons, year-over-year analysis, or custom reporting periods.
